name: revela_mono_imx219_color
description: The first full-colour pipeline: pedestal off, illuminant balanced, Hamilton-Adams demosaic in its two streaming stages, colour matrix, display curve -- and stats tapping the corrected Bayer for the 3A loops. Every block bit-exact against its model; this design is where they first meet as one machine.

inputs.name: sensor
inputs.description: Raw Bayer from the sensor receiver.

outputs.name: video
outputs.description: Tone-mapped RGB, three channels in one word.

nodes.description: Remove the sensor pedestal per CFA colour, before anything multiplies the signal.
Per-CFA-colour gain, written by the AWB loop at frame rate. Before demosaic: interpolating unbalanced planes bakes the imbalance into all three channels.
Hamilton-Adams green reconstruction, direction-adaptive; emits the (raw, green) word the chroma stage differences against.
Red and blue as colour differences against the reconstructed green.
Sensor RGB into the target colour space; calibration output, interpolated by colour temperature on the host.
Display tone curve per channel, one shared knot table. knots bits = bit_depth + 1 (10-bit path).
Per-zone colour and luminance accumulators for AE and AWB.

connections.description: A TAP, deliberately PRE-whitebalance: AWB must meter the illuminant's cast, and a loop that meters its own correction chases its tail.
